contracts.title: One visible answer from JSONL record
contracts.setup: JSONL dataset with one matching prompt/response and at least 20 distractor records in different domains
assertions: visible answer is the response field of the best-supported record
visible answer contains neither citations nor other records
metadata retains all selected citations and scores

contracts.title: No foreign result leakage
contracts.setup: Ranked evidence includes a Pythagoras record, a Lake Geneva record, a vitamin D record, and a programming record
assertions: answer is derived from the most relevant record
answer does not include the foreign records
no answer is certified as true solely by provenance

contracts.title: Details are separated from the chat body
contracts.setup: Synthetic TaskResult with answer, status, prompt hash, generation details, and sources
assertions: format_chat_result returns the answer text only
details formatter returns technical metadata without changing answer text

contracts.title: RAG evidence is injected into generation
contracts.setup: Known record with a distinctive answer and a test double generator
assertions: selected record content is present in generation context
generation is called after retrieval
rejected candidate leaves a readable structured-record fallback

contracts.title: No-evidence path is explicit
contracts.setup: Empty semantic corpus and no configured generation endpoint
assertions: no unrelated corpus record is returned
unresolved reason is visible and machine-traceable

contracts.title: Compatible AAM delegation
contracts.setup: A separate compatible workspace and a stubbed peer runtime
assertions: delegated prompt includes selected RAG records
delegation uses retrieval_policy=off in peer to prevent double retrieval
recursive delegation is rejected
peer runtime is closed after use

contracts.title: JSONL record preservation
contracts.setup: More than 30 JSONL records including a record larger than the micro-RAG text budget
assertions: records appear exactly once in source-derived chunks
long records are never cut
source file SHA-256 remains unchanged

contracts.title: Master→micro-RAG routing
contracts.setup: At least 25 micro-RAGs with one distinctive target record
assertions: tree contains master and micro nodes
search returns target record
only selected micro-RAG text files are loaded
read metrics report hierarchy levels and counts

contracts.title: Content integrity at read time
contracts.setup: Rebuilt index then one selected micro-RAG content file is altered
assertions: search rejects the modified content file
no modified text is returned as evidence

contracts.title: Context refinement depth
contracts.setup: Two related records, one coarse and one contextual variant
assertions: default depth returns the directly relevant response
detail depth can return additional context from child records
retrieved path explains which level was expanded

truth_policy: Tests verify retrieval, selection, formatting, provenance and refusal semantics; the expected factual answer exists only in synthetic test data, never in runtime branching.
